pinyin: wài sheng dǎ dēng long —— zhào jiù
literal: nephew carrying a lantern: lighting up uncle (照舅)
meaning: same as before (照舅 puns on 照旧 'as usual')
origin: Traditional two-part allegorical saying; the second half is often left unsaid.

pinyin: kǒng fū zǐ bān jiā —— jìng shì shū
literal: Confucius moving house: nothing but books (书)
meaning: always losing (书 shū puns on 输 'to lose')
origin: Traditional xiehouyu; common among card and mahjong players.

pinyin: hé shang dǎ sǎn —— wú fǎ wú tiān
literal: a monk under an umbrella: no hair, no sky (无发无天)
meaning: lawless, defying all rules (无法 puns on 无发)
origin: Traditional xiehouyu; Mao Zedong famously applied it to himself.

term: 哑巴吃黄连——有苦说不出
pinyin: yǎ ba chī huáng lián —— yǒu kǔ shuō bù chū
literal: a mute eating bitter herb: bitterness he cannot voice
meaning: suffering in silence; unable to complain
origin: Traditional xiehouyu (黄连 = goldthread, extremely bitter).

pinyin: zhú lán dǎ shuǐ —— yī chǎng kōng
literal: fetching water with a bamboo basket: all for nothing
meaning: all effort wasted

pinyin: xiǎo cōng bàn dòu fu —— yī qīng èr bái
literal: scallion with tofu: one green, one white
meaning: perfectly clear / completely innocent (清白)

term: 猪八戒照镜子——里外不是人
pinyin: zhū bā jiè zhào jìng zi —— lǐ wài bú shì rén
literal: Pigsy looking in a mirror: not human inside or out
meaning: blamed by both sides; can't win
origin: From Journey to the West's pig-demon Zhu Bajie.

equivalent.en: damned if you do, damned if you don't

term: 黄鼠狼给鸡拜年——没安好心
pinyin: huáng shǔ láng gěi jī bài nián —— méi ān hǎo xīn
literal: the weasel paying New Year respects to the hen: up to no good
meaning: a friendly gesture hiding bad intentions

equivalent.es: cuando la limosna es grande, hasta el santo desconfía

pinyin: ní pú sà guò jiāng —— zì shēn nán bǎo
literal: a clay Buddha crossing a river: can't even save itself
meaning: too troubled yourself to help others

equivalent.en: I can barely keep my own head above water

pinyin: zhàng èr hé shang —— mō bù zháo tóu nǎo
literal: a ten-foot-tall monk: you can't reach his head
meaning: completely confused

equivalent.en: I can't make heads or tails of it

pinyin: sī mǎ zhāo zhī xīn —— lù rén jiē zhī
literal: Sima Zhao's intentions: every passer-by knows them
meaning: an obvious hidden agenda
origin: Three Kingdoms period: Emperor Cao Mao said this of the ambitious regent Sima Zhao.

meaning: a rolling pin has no holes to blow through: totally clueless (一窍不通)
pinyin: gǎn miàn zhàng chuī huǒ —— yī qiào bù tōng
literal: blowing a fire with a rolling pin: no hole goes through

term: 秀才遇到兵——有理说不清
meaning: a scholar meeting soldiers: no use arguing, however right you are

equivalent.en: no use arguing with the unreasonable
equivalent.es: no hay manera de razonar con él

pinyin: xiù cái yù dào bīng —— yǒu lǐ shuō bù qīng
literal: scholar meets soldier: right but can't explain

meaning: a rat crossing the street: everyone shouts to hit it; a universally despised person
pinyin: lǎo shǔ guò jiē —— rén rén hǎn dǎ
literal: rat crosses the street: everyone yells to beat it

meaning: reading a libretto on a donkey: we'll see (走着瞧 means 'let's wait and see')

equivalent.en: we'll see how this turns out

pinyin: qí lǘ kàn chàng běn —— zǒu zhe qiáo
literal: reading while riding a donkey: look as you go

meaning: when you break a clay pot the crack runs to the bottom (璺 sounds like 问): ask until the very end

equivalent.en: get to the bottom of it

pinyin: dǎ pò shā guō —— wèn dào dǐ
literal: smash the clay pot: the crack goes all the way
origin: Pun: 璺 (wèn, crack) sounds like 问 (ask).

meaning: a turtle swallows a steelyard weight: its heart is iron; fully determined
pinyin: wáng bā chī chèng tuó —— tiě le xīn
literal: turtle swallowing an iron weight: iron heart

term: 千里送鹅毛——礼轻情意重
meaning: sending a goose feather over a thousand miles: the gift is small but the feeling is deep

equivalent.es: lo que cuenta es la intención

pinyin: qiān lǐ sòng é máo —— lǐ qīng qíng yì zhòng
literal: send a goose feather a thousand li

meaning: the Eight Immortals cross the sea: each shows their own magic; everyone uses their own methods

equivalent.es: cada uno con sus propios medios

pinyin: bā xiān guò hǎi —— gè xiǎn shén tōng
literal: Eight Immortals crossing the sea: each displays his power
origin: From the legend of the Eight Immortals.

meaning: a blind man lights a lamp: wasted wax; wasted effort
pinyin: xiā zi diǎn dēng —— bái fèi là
literal: blind man lighting a lamp: waste of wax
